'''Deepdocks''' were mobile [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="ISB" />

==Characteristics==
The smallest deepdock had three work bays, one of which could hold a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] and the others capable of holding ships smaller than [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]]. They were equipped with [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor-beam]] generators that could hold up to eight damaged ships at a time.<ref name="ISB" />

All deepdocks could travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], thus shortening repair time and avoiding [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attacks more easily.<ref name="ISB" />

==History==
The largest known deepdock was the [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili]] [[R/M Facility Number Four]], with 125 modular work bays, which could be reconfigured to support larger vessels.<ref name="ISB" />

As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] ground on, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] produced more and larger deepdocks to aid the war effort. At this time, standard deepdock fleets contained two deepdocks and 280 support vessels, along with engineering assets.<ref name="ISB" />
